protocol.filter: Existing causal 20-450 Hz bandpass plus 60/120/180 Hz notches, first-sample initialization and one-second warmup; reset at every acquisition gap
protocol.spectrum: Unrectified filtered waveform; demean within window; periodic Hann; one-sided density periodogram; no zero padding
protocol.features: Matched-window log1p RMS; four log1p band powers; four relative band powers; mean frequency; median frequency; normalized spectral entropy
protocol.relative_power_denominator: Total periodogram power in 20-450 Hz; zero-power relative and shape features are undefined
protocol.labels: Original torso-relative 3D camera-angle definitions; fixed +50 ms offset; no prompt targets; no interpolation across gaps >150 ms
protocol.clock: Existing first60%-OLS for arm-reach and unit slope/first60%-median receipt offset for picking; no spectral-label timing search
protocol.correlations: Pearson, Spearman and within-cue demeaned Pearson; all pairs are exploratory
protocol.source_selection: For each joint, select the spectral feature/channel with largest absolute within-cue correlation in arm-reach at 250 ms, excluding RMS. Keep that pair fixed for both picking recordings and the 125 ms sensitivity check. This is exploratory selection on an already examined source recording.
protocol.reference_pairs: EMG 1 log RMS against shoulder and elbow, on matching windows
protocol.uncertainty: 1000 paired block-bootstrap draws, seed17, within acquisition segment and round; 5 s primary, 2/10 s sensitivity. Recompute cue means within each draw. Pointwise descriptive intervals, no population p values or simultaneous-coverage claim.
protocol.diagnostics: Raw-before-software-filter and conditioned Welch PSDs, plus channel8 spectrograms; same gap/warmup handling. Channel8 chosen due to the previously observed amplitude shift.
protocol.scope: Spectral characterization and association only; no model retraining, accuracy claims, or hardware control

clocks.fit: first 60% of EMG device time; host receipt timestamps
unit slope; first 60% host receipt median offset
